enGB: For those who know how bonus stacking works and don't need reminders.
Some Crusade design makes no sense and needs fixing. See changelog for impact. Not as impactful as you might think.
Mythic Lich Deadly Magic spell trigger
Makes Mythic Lich Deadly Magic only trigger on spells. This avoids invisible triggers (ex: Belt of Demonic Shadow) silencing your party, but also nerfs it if you relied on abilities to trigger it.
